# GDG Web Dev Recruitment Portal

A modern, fast, and feature-rich recruitment portal built with Next.js, Firebase, and Better Auth. 

This repository contains the main application for onboarding, viewing departments, and managing recruitment through a comprehensive admin portal.

**Live App:** [https://gdg-webdev.vercel.app/](https://gdg-webdev.vercel.app/)

## Tech Stack
- Next.js (App Router)
- React
- Tailwind CSS
- Firebase (Admin & Firestore)
- Better Auth
- Framer Motion & GSAP
- Radix UI
